subject: Re: MAP draft - Data handling & compliance milestones
message_1_subject: MAP draft - Data handling & compliance milestones
message_1_body:
Thanks again for the call earlier today, David — good discussion. Per our agreement on the call, I attached a first-pass MAP focused on the Data Handling & Compliance milestone so your security and legal teams have something to react to.

High-level: we captured retention, logging/audit, and PHI/PII constraints and called out owner responsibilities and target dates so we can close procurement quickly. Summary of asks for Acme Health:
- Confirm retention windows for training vs. inference logs (prod vs. audit).
- Confirm whether PHI will be sent to Redwood inference endpoints or must be tokenized/masked before transit.
- Provide contact for your InfoSec reviewer and projected review timeline.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Acme Health to review attached MAP and return comments by EOW (Fri 08/21).
2) Redwood (Rishi) to prepare SOC 2 + KMS + logging detail package for legal/security review.
3) Joint review call next week to align on any redlines and finalize target close date (proposed 09/10/2026).

Attachments: 20260820-AcmeHealth-MAP-draft.pdf (MAP with milestones & responsibilities).

If this looks good, please confirm owners and any additional dependencies we should add to the MAP.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

On Thu, Aug 20, 2026 at 1:05 PM David Hunter <david.hunter@acmehealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks — quick Q on retention: our legal team expects 7 years for audit trails in regulated workflows. Is that something Redwood supports natively or do we need a custom export?
>
> -David
message_2_subject: Re: MAP draft - Data handling & compliance milestones
message_2_body:
Thanks Marissa — got the MAP. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Retention: for audit trails we need 7 years. For model training data we have a 3 year default.
2) PHI: yes, in the pilot we will be sending de-identified records, but long term we expect some workflows to include PHI; legal will require clarity on encryption in transit + at rest and whether Redwood processes or persists any identifiable data.
3) Logging: we need immutable audit logs (who accessed what, when) and the ability to export them to our SIEM.

I'll loop in our InfoSec reviewer (Sara) — Sara, can you confirm target review timing?

-David
message_3_cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sara Lee <sara.lee@acmehealth.com>
message_3_subject: Re: MAP draft - Data handling & compliance milestones
message_3_body:
Appreciate the quick reply, David — great context. Per your points, I've updated the MAP and added the following milestone table in the draft (see attached updated PDF). Key items called out: 

- Milestone: Audit log retention
  - Target close: 2026-09-03
  - Redwood owner: Rishi Malhotra (Security)
  - Acme owner: David Hunter (Legal/Compliance)
  - Dependencies: SIEM export format, retention SLA decision (7 yrs)

- Milestone: PHI handling & encryption
  - Target close: 2026-09-10
  - Redwood owner: Rishi Malhotra
  - Acme owner: Sara Lee
  - Dependencies: KMS integration, Data processing agreement language

- Milestone: Data residency & exports
  - Target close: 2026-09-08
  - Redwood owner: Laura Bennett (Solutions Eng)
  - Acme owner: David Hunter
  - Dependencies: region selection, VPC/private deployment feasibility assessment

Action items for this week:
- Rishi to compile SOC 2 and KMS documentation + architecture sketch (ETA 08/24).
- Laura to validate export formats we support and confirm SIEM integration helpers (ETA 08/25).
- Acme to confirm owners and whether 7-year retention is a hard requirement (David/Sara).

Attached: 20260824-AcmeHealth-data-questions.pdf (callouts and updated MAP milestones).

If Sara or legal have any immediate non-starters, flag them here and we can pull in our legal team. Otherwise, shall we tentatively schedule a joint review call for 08/26 or 08/27?

Thanks,
Marissa
message_4_body:
Quick internal note — I pulled the SOC 2 writeups and KMS keyflow diagram; packaging now. I'll include the logging retention options (7 yrs, 3 yrs, 90 days) and export mechanics to SIEM (S3->Kinesis connector or direct syslog). ETA to Marissa: EOD 08/24.

Laura — can you confirm whether our SIEM export helper supports the common Splunk and Sumo formats? If not, I'll include CSV and JSON export options as a fallback.

Will also draft suggested MAP language for the Data Processing Agreement to reduce back-and-forth on legal redlines.
